scope: Dated direct external reachability acceptance for the private NAS dashboard on TCP/1337; read-only UPnP and NAS network corroboration.

external_probe.vantage: Existing dedicated cloud host reached with repository cloud-command and pinned host identity
external_probe.target: Current home WAN IPv4; exact address omitted from durable receipt
ownership_verification: Established cloud home-IPsec VPN remote peer matched the live home gateway GetExternalIPAddress result exactly
Gateway is the documented home LAN router at 192.168.1.1

positive_control.target: Same home WAN, existing UPnP-advertised NAS Plex mapping

gateway_upnp.method: Unicast SSDP discovery, advertised root description, read-only GetExternalIPAddress and indexed GetGenericPortMappingEntry SOAP actions

nas_network.method: Committed qnap-recon recipe with existing dedicated NAS identity and pinned known-hosts file

limitations: A dated single-vantage probe establishes that the current public WAN TCP/1337 was unreachable from the cloud during this audit, not perpetual or universal isolation.
No complete static NAT/firewall or reverse-proxy audit was performed. Alternate public ports or other proxy/tunnel ingress paths were not certified absent.
The existing UniFi controller agent RSA attempt failed because the signing agent communication failed; it was not retried and no authentication setting was changed.
The documented DDNS hostname had no IPv4 answer from the cloud during the audit and was not used as the probe target.
NAS Plex has an existing public mapping; this receipt does not assert that the entire NAS or every NAS service is private.
UPnP mappings, WAN addressing and IPv6 state can change. Repeat checks after relevant networking changes.
reproduction: Read plan.md, usenet-infra/AGENTS.md and docs/operations/unifi-ssh-access.md; use existing dedicated cloud/NAS identities and strict pinned host-key checking.
Use cloud-command to inspect active VPN peer metadata, and use gateway read-only UPnP discovery/GetExternalIPAddress to correlate the current owned WAN. Do not reuse a stale public address.

From cloud-command, obtain the route to the verified public WAN and confirm the source/interface are public and outside the private IPsec selector. Attempt TCP/1337 three times with five-second timeouts.
Enumerate read-only UPnP GetGenericPortMappingEntry by index until error 713. Select NAS mappings and confirm none target internal TCP/1337.
Use an already-advertised owned NAS mapping for a single TCP-handshake positive control, if available; read no media. Do not create a mapping to manufacture evidence.
Run just --justfile usenet-infra/Justfile --working-directory usenet-infra qnap-recon and retain the dashboard listener, port binding and global IPv6 count.
